notes.subject: עיני
notes.rationale: Sepedi e ngwalwa ka 'pelo' fela — 'e bone ka pelo' (e bone pelo-ya-ka), e sego 'pelo-ya-ka' ka mošomo o tee.

notes.subject: go hlaba ka pelo
notes.rationale: 'Gomme pelo-ya-ka e bone manaba a ka' — e ka ba 'e bone' goba 'e bone sephiri seo se nyakilwego' — Hebreu o bolela fela go hlaba ka pelo, ka gobane e bolela 'e bone manaba a ka'.

notes.subject: על
notes.rationale: Ka bobedi bja diphetho, go bonala gore 'e bone ⟨go⟩ manaba' — ⟨go⟩ e hlakile ka bobedi bja mehlala.

translation: Gobane o ntšhitše go tšwa go bothata bohle; gomme pelo-ya-ka e bone manaba a ka!
